scope: First unexpected failures in the isolated queue/control study. Replays target the listed clean executable revision. Raw captured logs and traces are retained in .build/queue-control.

failures.first_symptom: All four L=1 balanced windows passed, then the supplemental small DROP replay failed the lossless assertion at queue_control.py:739.
failures.repair: Apply conservation to all stress replays, and retain real capacity rejections and idle edges in the diagnostic rows.

failures.first_symptom: An unconditional lossless assertion ended the run at L=2 after the first three balanced lengths. The L=2 mixed workload drops frames under the registered request timing.
failures.repair: Keep the exact beat-rate and zero-loss criterion in --expect-gate. Record the adverse performance result with complete drain accounting and continue the remaining cases.

failures.first_symptom: KeyError 'desc' on the first primary/direct/L1 descriptor-WAIT row, repeated on the same row at all profile, variant and latency combinations.
failures.repair: Read absent fields as absent on WAIT observations and still require exact old-grant and returned-owner identities.

failures.first_symptom: The mapper and STA reports completed, but the collector rejected valid paths because OpenSTA printed the asynchronous summary by path group without the word recovery.
failures.repair: Validate the exact release path startpoint and explicit recovery/removal endpoint type in the detailed path sections.

failures.repair: Select the asynchronous path group explicitly for recovery/removal. Report reset-to-write setup/hold separately and intersect the arrival envelopes.

failures.repair: Express the unsigned zero extension and one-bit mask predicates directly. The rebuilt scope passes with no width-warning suppression.
